notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded whole-object-class declaration teardown to the IEEE 1516.1-2025 clause-5 records exported by the Requirements Lab. The embedded profile removes the complete current ordinary publication set for an object class, including its implicit HLAprivilegeToDeleteObject publication, clears corresponding ownership on registered instances, and removes ordinary subscriptions at the exact class while retaining independent regional declarations. It remains source/test traceability only: save/restore interaction, transport, complete ownership arbitration, protected evidence, packaging, and conformance remain outside this slice.
